Hi team,

Following up from today's cross-functional sync — attaching the working QBR prep sheet (QBR_prep_sheet_v2.xlsx). High level asks from execs that we need to resolve before Thursday: 

- Confirm north-star metrics to show for capacity optimizations (finance wants expected unit cost delta).
- Finalize the list of roadmap exceptions we will surface, and owners for mitigation plans.
- Procurement needs an updated SOW outline by Wednesday EOD for the Dedicated capacity pilot.

Actionable items I captured in the meeting (short):
1) Karthik: provide one-slide summary of tradeoffs (latency vs quantization) + expected cost impact.
2) Vivek: consolidate SLA exceptions and proposed fallbacks (region + model variant).
3) Lauren: pull portfolio asks from GTM and confirm which customers to include in the QBR call.

Please update the tracker in the Drive folder (link below) when you have changes. I left comments on rows 3, 7 and 12 that need owners.

Thanks Marissa — good notes. I'll take the tradeoff slide and a short appendix with numbers. Early answers inline below: 

> Confirm north-star metrics to show for capacity optimizations (finance wants expected unit cost delta).
- Will show: 1) median p99 latency (ms), 2) tokens per dollar (hosted vs dedicated vs quantized), 3) expected delta after batching + prefix cache. Target: single table with conservative and optimistic scenarios.

> Finalize the list of roadmap exceptions we will surface, and owners for mitigation plans.
- Working list attached. I propose we surface the following exceptions: GPU memory fragmentation (owner: Vivek), model-compat rollback risk for quantized variants (owner: Karthik), and regional capacity shortfall for APAC (owner: Lauren).

> Procurement needs an updated SOW outline by Wednesday EOD for the Dedicated capacity pilot.
- Will coordinate with Procurement lead; Marissa/Laura please confirm the MRR/commit numbers we want in the SOW draft.

I updated the Drive with a one-pager draft (folder link), and uploaded MA_planning_summary.pdf to the tracker.

Next steps (owners & dates):
- Karthik: one-slide tradeoffs + appendix (Tue EOD)
- Vivek: SLA exception mitigation bullets (Wed noon)
- Lauren: list of customers to highlight for QBR (Wed EOD)
- Marissa: SOW draft framework (Wed EOD)

I'll pull this together into the exec slide deck after you confirm.

- Fragmentation mitigation is low-effort: nightly compaction pipeline + monitoring alert. Impact: reduces probability of degraded throughput by ~40% (conservative).
- Regional fallback: add a model-variant route to EU for APAC peering fallback; ops cost estimated in the MA_planning_summary.pdf.

I'll add the owner tags in the tracker and put a short blurb for each mitigation.
